title: Cross-Sectional Heterogeneity in LSTM Networks for Financial Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2608.05755v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predicting financial asset returns remains one of the most difficult challenges in empirical finance, driven by the low signal-to-noise ratio and the semi-strong form of market efficiency. While deep learning models, especially LSTM networks, have shown promise in capturing temporal dependencies, standard architectures often struggle to account for the cross-sectional heterogeneity of asset returns. This paper proposes a novel architectural extension to the basic LSTM model designed to improve both predictive accuracy and model interpretability. The framework integrates macro-financial covariates to capture broader economic signals and learnable sector embeddings to encompass heterogeneity by sector. The trading strategy involves constructing a long-short portfolio based on daily directional forecasts for each S&P 500 constituent, targeting stocks expected to under- or outperform the cross-sectional median return of the S&P 500. translated_title: 金融时间序列中LSTM网络的截面异质性研究
translated_abstract: 预测金融资产收益仍然是实证金融中最困难的挑战之一，这源于低信噪比和市场半强式有效性。虽然深度学习模型，特别是LSTM网络，在捕捉时间依赖性方面展现出潜力，但标准架构往往难以解释资产收益的截面异质性。本文提出了一种对基础LSTM模型的创新架构扩展，旨在提高预测准确性和模型可解释性。该框架整合了宏观金融协变量以捕捉更广泛的经济信号，并引入可学习的行业嵌入以涵盖行业间的异质性。交易策略基于对标准普尔500指数每个成分股的每日方向预测构建多空组合，目标是选择预期跑赢或跑输标准普尔500指数截面中位数收益的股票。
tldr: 本文提出一种扩展LSTM架构，通过引入宏观金融协变量和可学习行业嵌入来捕捉金融时间序列的截面异质性，从而提高预测精度和可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an extended LSTM architecture that incorporates macro-financial covariates and learnable sector embeddings to capture cross-sectional heterogeneity in financial time series, enhancing predictive accuracy and interpretability.
